title: DevOps Easy Learning quiz bank (owner 2026-11-28)
description: A lesson's quiz (<lesson folder>/quiz.json) or an assessment (<course>/assessments/module-<n>-assessment.json, final-assessment.json, scenario-<name>.json), as GEN delivers them. Questions only from the course's own content. Counts follow docs/COURSE_STANDARD.md §8a (by video length: <5 min 3–5, 5–10 5–8, 10–20 8–12, 20–30 10–15, 30–45 15–20, 45–60 20–25, >60 25–30+; module assessment 15–30, final 30–60). The publisher checks every file (tools/mcp-server/src/quizfile.ts) and the API checks the questions again. Placement: a module assessment and its scenarios close their module; the final assessment closes the last module, before the closing article.

kind.description: Assessments. The file name decides; a different kind here is reported.

course.description: Assessments: the course plan folder under courses/ (informational).

title.description: Assessments: the lesson title shown (default 'Module <n> assessment', 'Final assessment', 'Scenario: <name>').

module.description: Module (1-based) a module assessment or scenario closes. For module files the n in the file name is used.

scenario.description: Scenario files: the situation shown above the questions.

code.description: Scenario files: logs, config or output shown with the scenario.

settings.description: Optional (assessments): draw a sample per attempt, from this file or also from the module's or course's lesson quizzes.

id.description: Stable id, unique in the course (keep it when editing the question, so students' results stay linked).

code.description: A snippet shown with the question (config, command output, code).

options.description: Realistic options (GEN uses 3–5); no obviously wrong fillers; never the same option twice.

correct.description: Index of the right option (0 = the first).

why.description: Why the right answer is right.

explanations.description: One per option, same order: why it is right or wrong.

takeaway.description: The lesson or best practice to remember.

type.description: GEN's names 'code/config analysis', 'real-world scenario' and 'critical thinking' are stored as code, scenario and critical-thinking.

topic.description: Used for the per-topic score summary.

timestamp.description: Seconds into the video where this is taught ('Watch this part'): the lesson's own video, or in assessments the video of `lesson`. Must be inside that video.

lesson.description: Assessments: the lesson folder the question comes from (must be in the course plan).

related.description: Assessments: other places the topic is covered (shown as extra 'watch' links).

fixedOrder.description: Keep the options in this order (e.g. 'all of the above'); otherwise they are shuffled per attempt.
